gitCommit.subject: Close authz holes in sort-results / sessions / preferences APIs (purses-axn, 51h, 33u) (#200)
gitCommit.body:
Close authz holes in sort-results / sessions / preferences APIs (purses-axn, 51h, 33u) (#200)

* docs(purses-axn): design spec for API authz cluster (axn+51h+33u)

Close cross-tenant write/IDOR holes across the whole /api/sort-results/**
subtree, curator-scope session-list GETs (33u), add the missing membership
gate to preferences routes (51h), delete dead DecisionController (33u).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* docs(purses-axn): implementation plan for API authz cluster

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* docs(purses-axn): plan v2 — fold in adversarial-review findings (shares IDOR, SharePanel gate, inline guard)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(purses-axn): requireApiResultAccess guard (collection + curator scope)

* fix(purses-axn): guard sort-results [id] core routes (collection+curator)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(purses-axn): guard sort-results items+shares; belongs-to-parent for [rid] and [sid]

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(purses-axn): POST /api/sort-results routes through repo + collection guard (allocates number)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(purses-axn): render SharePanel only for the result's curator (no 403-on-click)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(purses-33u): curator-scope session-list GETs (close cross-curator read leak)

GET /api/sessions and GET /api/collections/[id]/sessions passed the
collection-access gate but returned ALL curators' sessions to any member
(a within-collection read leak). Scope both list GETs to the caller's own
sessions via SessionRepository.findByCollectionAndCurator, matching the
already-curator-scoped pages (t9l). Tier-1 access gate preserved; POST
untouched. Remove now-dead sessionsTable/eq imports from the flat route.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(purses-51h): add membership gate to preferences GET/DELETE routes

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* chore(purses-33u): delete dead DecisionController (live route guards its own writes)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test(purses-axn): cover belongs-to-parent on all child methods + DELETE/shares-POST authz (final-review gap)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

---------

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
